newsitem.title: UK: IPE GAS OIL CLOSES LOWER, VOLUMES THIN.
newsitem.headline: IPE GAS OIL CLOSES LOWER, VOLUMES THIN.

text.p: IPE August gas oil ended down $1.50 a tonne on Monday in a market consolidating after Friday's sharp fall, brokers said.
August gas oil lost $1.5 on the day to close right on support at $168 a tonne.
"It needs to hold $168. It dipped earlier this morning but only saw a few lots trade. For the moment it's hanging in there," one broker said.

September Brent crude recovered from the day's lows to trade at 1700 GMT down two cents at $18.46 a barrel. NYMEX unleaded gasoline led the market to the lows earlier but brokers said a period of consolidation was needed after last weeks losses.
"It's very quiet and hard to call a direction. It's due a breather and has more consolidation to do," one broker said.
Traders said the expected 1.5 million barrels per day of Iraqi crude until the end of the month at least was already factored into the crude price.
"There may be a bit of a fall when we actually see the first barrels flow but overall it's in the price," one said.
